unlabeledProtocol.expected: Retain six equally plausible role-position permutations and abstain.
unlabeledProtocol.claim: No role direction can be inferred from word order alone without grounding or supervision.

weakSupervision.input: Sentence strings and two or more explicit frame assignments. No target order rule is provided.
weakSupervision.algorithm: Enumerate the six permutations of subject/predicate/object over three positions. Score each by the fraction of distinct labeled examples whose token at each position equals the assigned frame slot. Accept only a unique perfect candidate supported by at least two distinct examples. Duplicate token/frame evidence is deduplicated. Contradictions prevent acceptance. Reported confidence is the best candidate score multiplied by min(1, distinct-example-count / 2); it is a heuristic, not a calibrated probability.

conditions.B: Exact teaching-example retrieval; no pattern application.
conditions.C: Weakly supervised candidate induction from training examples.
conditions.D: Supplied SUBJECT/ACTION/OBJECT order; reference condition, not learning.

metrics.exactFrameAccuracy: Exact subject, predicate, and object frame divided by examples in the category; abstentions count incorrect.
metrics.abstentionAccuracy: Correctly returning no frame for unsupported, unknown-token, and out-of-scope inputs divided by such examples.
metrics.unsupportedAcceptanceRate: Supported frame emitted for examples marked unsupported divided by unsupported examples.
metrics.patternAcceptance: A pattern is accepted only if one candidate has perfect support over at least two distinct labeled examples and strictly exceeds the runner-up.
metrics.latency: Repeated wall-clock observations; nearest-rank p50/p95 and observation count, descriptive only.
